description: Source code for a program that sends a USB port reset to a USB device, including functions for device discovery, reset, and user interaction.

classes.name: usbentry
classes.description: Structure representing a USB device with bus number, device number, vendor and product IDs, and names.

methods.name: sysfs_attr
methods.description: Reads a specific attribute from sysfs for a given device.

methods.name: parse_devlist
methods.description: Parses the device list directory to find USB devices.

methods.name: find_device
methods.description: Finds a USB device based on bus/device numbers, vendor/product IDs, or product name.

methods.name: reset_device
methods.description: Sends a reset command to the specified USB device.
